hard-review.case: line localization only; manual explanation review required

findings.explanation: Eligibility (observed_at <= asof < expires_at) is not checked during the selection of the latest row. A future or expired row with a later observed_at will incorrectly suppress earlier eligible rows.

datetime.fromisoformat returns naive datetimes for inputs without timezone info, causing TypeError when comparing against the aware asof datetime in line 12. The code does not handle arbitrary offsets or Z correctly to ensure awareness.
The condition observed <= asof <= expires uses <= for expires_at, but the contract requires asof < expires_at (strict inequality).
Tie-breaking logic is missing: when observed_at instants are equal, the code does not select the smallest id, nor does it preserve the first input row for identical instant/id.
